name: Sprint Build
description: Build the story end to end: brief, red tests, implementation, gate and coverage

name: Code Quality
description: Review the change for code quality against the shared standards

name: Test Quality
description: Review the test suite for quality and coverage of the business rules

name: Functional Test
description: Run the story's functional unit tests end to end against the running app

name: UX Test
description: Review the built pages against the design system, theme and information architecture

name: Human Review
description: Sandro reads the diff and every finding is fixed and prevented

name: Documentation
description: Bring the design docs and CLAUDE.md files back in sync with the change

name: PM Update
description: Reconcile the tracking artifacts with the finished story

name: Commit
description: Commit the reviewed change with a Conventional Commits message

name: Brief
description: Write the build brief from the spec and the design docs

name: Red
description: Write the failing test suite the implementation must turn green

name: Implement
description: Make the failing tests pass without touching them

name: Gate
description: Run type-check, lint, tests and build until all four pass

name: Coverage
description: Raise coverage to the enforced thresholds

name: Smoke
description: Smoke-test the built pages in a real browser

name: Handoff
description: Hand the green, uncommitted build over for review
